text: Shira - engaged!! Pieter proposed in Lisbon last wknd, on the bridge at sunset apparently, ring was his gran's. wedding prob over the summer next yr, venue tbc. her parents already pushing for Tel Aviv, his want Rotterdam, so that'll be fun. she's def doing a hen, wants a spa thing not a club. get them an engagement card this wk

call Mai re: her sister's wedding - she's maid of honour + panicking about the speech

Anil - into cricket, plays Sundays for a village side. vegetarian. allergic to cashews
Layla's bro Jamal graduating from Leeds 3rd of July. she's going up w/ their dad

Shira - wedding planning: venue booked for 21/06, now stressing abt guest list. her mum wants 200 ppl lol

gym 6:30 tmrw. meal prep Sun

Keisha & Ravi anniv dinner booked for the 12th, but Ravi doesn't know yet. remind me the day after to ask how it went

Ayesha - Mrs Shah's funeral was yesterday. Ayesha v quiet. pop round sometime next week w/ food

Florin - wife Caroline's sister getting married in Romania 16 Aug, they're flying out the wk before. he hates flying

Mai - wedding planning chat: Svetlana doing the cake, Ming the flowers, Jamal DJing. ceremony 14 May @ the registry office then reception in her uncle's garden. Mai worried about rain. I said I'd help set up the morning of. need to get her a gift off the list by end of April too

Anil wants to make a photo book of her life, asked if I had pics from the old days. dig some out + send them sometime next week. also his kid's school play is 10/12, the week after the party at work, Anil's v proud she got a speaking part
